text: Artificial intelligence is changing the world of creativity. Today, AI can generate paintings, compose music, and even write stories. These tools are impressive—they can imitate famous styles or create new sounds in seconds. However, many people wonder if this is true creativity. A human artist uses personal experiences, emotions, and imagination. A machine, on the other hand, analyzes patterns from existing data and combines them in new ways. So, while AI can produce beautiful and useful works, it lacks real feeling or intention. Perhaps the best approach is collaboration: humans can guide AI with ideas and emotions, while AI offers speed and endless possibilities. In this way, creativity grows, not disappears.
